NHAI pilots SMS alert system for uninsured vehicles at toll plazas

The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) has begun a pilot trial of a new system at the Mundka toll plaza on Urban Extension Road-II (UER-II) in Delhi. This system aims to identify vehicles operating on highways without valid insurance. Upon passing a toll plaza, vehicles found to be uninsured will trigger an SMS alert. A report indicates that a fine of ₹10,000 may be imposed for such violations.
